title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Dodge Viper
description:
The Dodge Viper, one of the loudest and most brutal American sports cars ever made, started with no door handles, no airbags, no traction control and no A B S. Its V ten engine was partly cast by Lamborghini. And in the end, the car that began with no safety equipment at all was killed by a safety rule. There are two things about the Viper that you probably did not know, and both are in published sources. The first is about who really helped build that engine, and how small the team was. The second is about what the Viper did not have for twenty-one years, and the date when it finally got it. Every fact in this video comes from published sources, listed in the description. Where sources disagree, we will say so.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
